decisions.reason: Changing KiCad 3D-model references from absolute to project-relative paths does not alter BOM contents, component identifiers, or assembly population rules.
The path-portability correction does not change component selection, availability, cost, or JLCPCB sourcing policy.
The corrected local 3D-model paths do not change the assistance required for configuring or reviewing a JLCPCB order.
The production package remains defined as Gerbers, drill files, pick-and-place data, and BOM; the 3D-model reference policy does not modify that file set.
The source decision concerns portable 3D-model file references and does not change the ESP32 module model, breakout access, placement, style, or pitch.
Repairing KiCad library paths does not change the enclosure's contained hardware, mounting, airflow, assembly, or retention requirements.
The source decision does not alter any GPIO assignment, availability constraint, or compatibility rule.
The modular interboard interface was already removed by the integrated-board decision, and relative 3D-model paths do not change that retained removal fact.
The KiCad path correction does not modify the AXP2101 electrical topology, battery behavior, charging behavior, or power rails.
The project-relative 3D-model reference policy does not affect ESP32 decoupling values or capacitor placement.
The source decision does not change I2C cable length, speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or their placement.
The relative-path correction affects how 3D assets are located, not the LED board's selected part number, model identity, package, color format, or LED count.
